evidence.section: Full paper: Memory-Augmented Self Calibration with Normal Reference Examples
evidence.paraphrase: A fixed bank of few-shot visual references is retrieved to ground anomaly reasoning.

evidence.section: Full paper: Memory-Augmented Self Calibration with Normal Reference Examples
evidence.paraphrase: During operation, AnomalyAgent applies evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence to few-shot visual reference memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

evidence.section: Full paper: Memory-Augmented Self Calibration with Normal Reference Examples
evidence.paraphrase: During operation, AnomalyAgent applies LLM-mediated memory editing to few-shot visual reference memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF pp. 5–6): Normal references, fixed-weight prototype updates, and reflection notes are written during operation; these are T2 state revision and editing. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
